pages.text: “Hidden in deep forests, growing within decayed wood, gentle yet nourishing, strengthening the body.”$(br2)Poria is a valuable fungus that thrives in the depths of the forest. Its root is rich in nutrients and widely used in medicine and tea brewing. Humble yet mysterious, it quietly spreads along fallen logs or pine tree roots, offering vitality to travelers.

Wild poria primarily grows deep within forests, usually parasitizing fallen logs or ancient tree roots, silently absorbing nutrients.$(br)Unlike most plants, poria does not rely on seeds for reproduction. Instead, harvested poria roots can be directly buried in the soil to continue growing, making it ideal for cyclical cultivation.

A mature poria plant yields multiple poria roots, which can be continuously cultivated.$(br)Poria root is rich in warming and nourishing components, making it an excellent ingredient for restorative teas, helping travelers regain energy and endurance on their journeys.
